label: Camera iris (closes, snaps open on a photo)
description: A camera IRIS: six dark graphite blades (each built from its two aperture vertices, both edge extensions and the short arc between them, with a subtle edge highlight) inside a shape -- a circle, or a rounded rect (a framed print). It can grow out of the shape before it: with `from` (e.g. the black pill, carrying the same label) the pill swells into the circle while the blades close over it. The blades close to a small hexagonal aperture at close_at, snap open at open_at onto the photo, and the photo stays in the shape (object-fit cover) until hide_at. The relay open's second beat (the click on the pill -> iris -> photo) and the wall beat (the iris closes over the black print rectangle and opens onto the print). Handoff: at `at` it draws exactly the `from` box (and label), so the previous piece hides at the same moment; after the open it is a photo at x/y/w/h (the iris circle: centre 0.5/0.5, diameter 0.30). Full-frame. Examples: {"from":{"x":0.5,"y":0.5,"w":0.3,"h":0.085},"label":"Develop","image":"/assets/door.jpg","at":2.3,"close_at":2.35,"open_at":2.6}; the print: {"shape":"rect","w":0.3,"h":0.4,"radius":0.004,"backdrop":"#0b0b0c","image":"/assets/astronaut.jpg","at":1.0,"close_at":1.05,"open_at":1.5}.

image.label: The photo shown through the aperture once it opens (URL)

x.label: Centre, fraction of the frame width

y.label: Centre, fraction of the frame height

w.label: Width (circle: diameter), fraction of the frame width

h.label: Height, fraction of the frame height (default: the same pixel size as w)

radius.label: rect: corner radius, fraction of the frame's shorter side

from.label: The shape it grows out of at `at`: {x, y, w, h, radius? (omitted = fully round), color? (default #0b0b0c)}

label.label: The label the `from` shape carries (white Geist 600, label_size x its height -- the same rule as wordmark-squeeze's pill), covered by the blades

label_size.label: Label size as a fraction of the from-shape height

backdrop.label: Colour inside the shape until the blades have closed (default: from.color, or transparent without from)

at.label: When it appears (s); with `from`, the morph into the shape starts here

morph_duration.label: Seconds the from-shape takes to become the shape

close_at.label: When the blades start to close (default at + 0.1)

open_at.label: When the blades snap open onto the photo (default close end + 0.1)

closed_aperture.label: The closed hexagon's size, fraction of the shape's half size

turn.label: Degrees the blades turn as they close

hide_at.label: The iris (and its photo) vanish instantly
